ValidationRule.description: When Primary Product Line = Digital Solutions, Is Insight proposed cannot be blank
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Standard_Opportunity", RecordType.DeveloperName = "IME_Standard_Opportunity"), (OR( ISPICKVAL( StageName, "2 - Solution Developed"), ISPICKVAL( StageName, "3 - Solution Agreed"), ISPICKVAL( StageName, "4 - Negotiate"), ISPICKVAL( StageName, "5 - Signed/PO in"))), ISPICKVAL( Primary_Product_Line__c , "Digital Solutions"), ISBLANK(Is_InSight_being_proposed__c ), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Must fill out Is Insights being Proposed.
